attributes.action: Strict protocol to how much information is released immediately on suspects
attributes.additional_details: I believe that with what’s going on within the United Kingdom currently with mass immigration and certain religions been higher population of these said immigrants, we could try lower the division by having stricter release policies on suspects
attributes.background: I believe that if we had firm protocols in place to how much information the media released or the police released we would prevent division and stop the spread of unrest between communities. People jump to conclusions or making assumptions isn’t helping the situation

rejection.details:
Petitions need to call on the Government or Parliament to take a specific action.

We're not sure exactly what you'd like the Government or Parliament to do.

You could start a new petition explaining clearly what type of information regarding suspects that you would like the media or police to be allowed to be released.

You may also wish to sign this petition: https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/776967
